description: This source file exports theme-related functions and constants, specifically for managing and applying a dark theme in a frontend application. It imports theme styles and tokens from a local darkTheme module and provides functions to set and retrieve the current theme.

methods.name: setTheme(themeName = "dark")
methods.description: Sets the current theme to 'dark' and returns the theme tokens used for styling components. Currently supports only 'dark' theme.

methods.name: getCurrentTheme()
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme ('dark' by default), reading from the 'data-theme' attribute of the document's root element.
